All unit tests pass (1292 pass, 0 fail). 

The fix: in the `copy()` methods of `Mesh`, `Line`, `Points`, and `Sprite`, the material is now cloned as an array when it is one:

```js
this.material = Array.isArray( source.material ) ? source.material.slice() : source.material;
```

This ensures `clone()` gives each object its own materials array (sharing the material instances themselves), while single-material objects keep sharing the reference as before.
